_meta.description: Query composition templates. Combine phrases from other libraries via placeholders. No card IDs. Generator fills {trigger}/{effect}/... from slot libraries.
_meta.composition_rule: 1) parse card into bindings 2) pick a template whose required slots are available 3) sample a phrase for each slot 4) optionally LLM-paraphrase within slot meaning
_meta.placeholder_fill: Replace each {slot} with one phrase from that library. Optional slots may be omitted if the template lists them under optional_slots or if text still reads cleanly after drop.

EFFECT_TARGET.label: Effect + Target (Spell Resolve)
EFFECT_TARGET.note: For instants/sorceries without a creature trigger.

SHORTHAND_BAG.label: Mechanic Shorthand Bag
SHORTHAND_BAG.note: Compact bags like 'ETB draw'. Slot fill still comes from libraries.

CREATE_TOKEN.label: Token Creation Constraints
CREATE_TOKEN.note: Every listed token slot is optional: a partial query only constrains fields it supplies.

NAME_ANCHORED.label: Name-Anchored Query
NAME_ANCHORED.note: {name} filled at compose time. Use sparingly to avoid name overfitting; prefer mechanic slots.

create_token_render.equal_count: creature tokens equal to the relevant count
create_token_render.fixed_unknown: a fixed number of creature tokens

FULL_BINDING_ALL.use_when: synthetic training sample must expose every binding slot

NAME_ANCHORED.note: name may already be inside trigger phrase if uses_name
